# BioPlayground

BioPlayground: An evolutionary sandbox for introducing selective pressures and monitoring population drift in engineered systems. it allows researchers to test the robustness of synthetic organisms under diverse environmental conditions.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Seeded Wright-Fisher selection/mutation/drift implemented; repeat plus independent entropy/heterozygosity check pass. Biological robustness not established; preliminary unit contains a second sentence because lowercase it was not split.

text: BioPlayground provides a powerful platform for directed evolution and ecological modeling, helping researchers understand how functions are maintained.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Directed-evolution score resampling and explicit Lotka-Volterra utilities exist; no real engineered-organism forecast or measured learning benefit.

# PDX Insight

PDX Insight: A monitoring tool for Patient-Derived Xenografts that ensures they accurately represent patient biology over time.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Cannot ensure patient biology fidelity. Omitted profiles produce perfect MFI and label mutations measured; independent regression fails on omitted-data provenance.

text: It calculates a "Model Fidelity Index" and identifies translational drift using multi-omic data.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Multiomic score/drift arithmetic exists; measured-layer classification is wrong for omitted mutation evidence. No validated translational accuracy.

text: PDX Insight suggests CRISPR-based restoration strategies to maintain model accuracy, improving the reliability of preclinical drug testing.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Restoration target suggestions from lost mutation labels exist, not actual restoration or improved preclinical reliability. No biological action executed.

# Phage-Tx

Phage-Tx: A predictive model for phage therapy efficacy that simulates the coevolutionary arms race between bacteriophages and their bacterial hosts.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Stiff coevolution ODE exists and suite passes; source explicitly says no therapeutic efficacy claim. No external efficacy benchmark reproduced.

text: It suggests optimal phage cocktails for targeting resistant strains and identifies modifications.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
